grammar.summary: 本课学习表"缺乏"的 be short of 与 safe to drink 结构。

points.title: be short of 表缺乏
points.explanation: The country is short of clean water. short of = 缺少，形容词短语的动词化功能。

examples.en: Many areas are short of safe water.
examples.cn: 许多地区缺乏安全饮用水。

points.title: 形容词 + to do 的主动表被动
points.explanation: The water is safe to drink. = 喝起来安全。不定式主动形式表被动含义。

examples.en: The water is not safe to drink.
